field.name: in_additional_exemption_65_plus
field.comment: Indiana additional exemption $500 for age 65+ (if federal AGI below threshold: $40,000 single, $20,000 MFS). Source: IN DOR

field.name: in_adjusted_agi
field.comment: Indiana AGI after military exclusions (computed from federal AGI)

field.name: in_agi_threshold_mfs
field.comment: Indiana AGI threshold for age 65+ exemption - Married Filing Separately

field.name: in_agi_threshold_single
field.comment: Indiana AGI threshold for age 65+ exemption - Single filers

field.name: in_military_retirement_exclusion
field.comment: Indiana military retirement exclusion (computed). 100% of military retirement pay exempt per IC 6-3-2-3.7. Extended to Space Force, USPHS, NOAA Corps in 2025. MOAA Grade A

field.name: in_msrra_compliant
field.comment: Indiana honors MSRRA (Military Spouses Residency Relief Act). Military spouse income exempt if different domicile

field.name: in_personal_exemption
field.comment: Indiana personal exemption $1,000 per person (taxpayer + spouse if MFJ). Source: IN DOR

field.name: in_sbp_exclusion
field.comment: Indiana Survivor Benefit Plan (SBP) exclusion (computed). 100% of SBP payments exempt

field.name: in_scra_compliant
field.comment: Indiana honors SCRA (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act). Active duty pay exempt if different state of residence

field.name: in_tax_rate
field.comment: Indiana flat income tax rate 3.00% (2025). Reduced from 3.05% in 2024. Source: Indiana Department of Revenue https://www.in.gov/dor/

field.name: in_taxable_income
field.comment: Indiana taxable income (computed). AGI minus exemptions

field.name: in_total_exemptions
field.comment: Indiana total exemptions (computed). Base exemptions + age 65+ if eligible

field.name: in_total_military_exclusion
field.comment: Total Indiana military income exclusion (computed). Sum of military retirement and SBP exclusions

field.name: state_tax_liability
field.comment: Indiana state tax liability (computed). IN taxable income × 3.00% flat rate
